subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Ecstasy
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'Bliss'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word:

 
 
• Ecstasy- a state of extreme happiness, especially when feeling pleasure.
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the correct answer:
 
 
• ​Bliss- complete happiness.
 
 
 
• Clearly, the word 'Bliss' is closest in meaning to the given word 'Ecstasy'.
 
• Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is 'Bliss'.
